observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Power Deluxe 18-inch rechargeable fan.
The model number PFRC-45-13 is clearly printed on the box.
The box lists features including 5 blades, 4 speeds, USB output, DC ports, a solar panel, and two bulbs.
The actual fan and its accessories are not visible; only the box is shown.
The box appears to be in good condition and possibly shrink-wrapped.

claims.claim: Strong light LED make the lamp more brighter
claims.evidence: The box mentions an LED light, but no photo shows the light operating to confirm brightness.
This is a marketing claim that cannot be verified from a photo of the box.
While the box looks clean, the actual item is not shown to confirm it is unused.

risks.if_unproven: priced as an empty box or scrap

Photo of the solar panel and the two LED bulbs mentioned on the box.
